note: Static explainers for Macro Engine pillars, keyed by engine row id. Content: Hercules (COLLAB.md spec, 2026-10-08). Update `live` as conditions change.

policy.title: Policy divergence
policy.body: Central banks moving in different directions. It is the gap between them that moves currencies: money flows toward higher rates.
policy.live: CPI broke the October hold: core beat twice; October 27–28 a coin flip (~43–54%), December effectively fully priced. 2Y spiked ~4.95%, settled 4.80%; 10Y 5.33% → ~5.27%. Beige Book hot-leaning; Goolsbee: ‘discouraging.’ ECB Oct ~12%/Dec live; BoJ Oct ~9%/Dec >80%; BoE Nov 5 ~86%; RBA Nov 2–3; BoC/RBNZ Oct 28.

growth.title: Growth differentials
growth.body: Who is accelerating, who is stalling (GDP, jobs, PMIs). Always comparative. Stronger growth pulls in capital and raises hike expectations.
growth.live: No new growth print moved a currency — CPI owned the tape. UK GDP Thu 1:00am CT (fcst -0.1%) is the next growth-vs-hike test; China exports +36.3% export-led, not a domestic breakout.

inflation.title: Inflation
inflation.body: CPI/PCE vs the central bank's target. High inflation alone strengthens nothing — what matters is what the bank does about it.
inflation.live: September CPI: 3.7% y/y (vs 3.6%), core 0.3% m/m + 2.6% y/y (both beats) — broadening past energy. Pipeline: German WPI +8.7% y/y (hottest since Feb 2023); China PPI +5.0%. Beige Book: ‘higher oil prices permeated all District reports.’ October is live again.

risk.title: Risk sentiment
risk.body: Risk-on vs risk-off. Fear bids USD, JPY, CHF (havens) and sells AUD, NZD, GBP (risk proxies).
risk.live: Rate repricing, not a fear bid — and it partially faded (2Y 4.95% → 4.80%). Yen the holdout: USD/JPY round-tripped the spike, flat. Franc sleeping. AUD $0.70 failed; NZD near low. Silver -3% to -6%.

tot.title: Terms of trade
tot.body: Export prices vs import prices: oil, metals. The same price moves two currencies opposite ways — say which and why.
tot.live: Brent ~$106.56 / WTI ~$95.66, spread ~$10.9 — Aramco confirmation + two Hormuz vessel strikes (one sunk); OPEC cut 2026 demand a 6th straight time. CAD's offset won the day (USD/CAD flat). Gold ~$4,080 (-2%): rate leg won.

positioning.title: Positioning
positioning.body: Where speculators already stand (CFTC COT, Fridays). Crowded trades are fragile: if everyone is long dollars, nobody is left to buy. The contrarian lens — where would a surprise hurt most.
positioning.live: Crowded USD longs (~$35.5bn) got paid on the hot print — unwind risk flips to a soft PPI. EUR shorts (~0th pctile) and AUD record shorts also profited; squeeze setups loaded but denied. Next COT Friday.

fiscal.title: Fiscal & sovereign risk
fiscal.body: Deficits, debt sustainability, sovereign spreads. Funds stress leaks into the currency.
fiscal.live: France cleared the first hurdle (rejection motion failed 236–149); revenue vote Oct 20, Moody's Oct 23 ahead. German 30y held at 3.8% — no duration fear. No new US fiscal development.
